command.title.note: on `CommandDefinition` and `@server.command`; same surfaces as TypeScript, without `listCommands()`

command.safety-flags.note: on `CommandDefinition`, `define_command` and `@server.command`; same surfaces as TypeScript

command.approval-policy.note: on `CommandDefinition`, `define_command` and `@server.command`; same surfaces as TypeScript, and `afd validate` warns on a mutation or destructive tool without one

command.confirmations.note: `create_server(confirmations=...)`, elicitation on 2026-07-28 and stateful 2025 connections; client `on_elicitation`, CLI prompt

command.kebab-names.note: warns in `define_command` and in the core registry for a raw definition

command.reserved-names.note: meta-tools always, bootstrap names with `bootstrap=True` and context names with `contexts` (#1731); duplicates too

command.input-validation.note: advertised JSON Schema enforced before middleware, then Pydantic conversion where applicable

command.output-schema.note: `_meta.outputSchema` and top-level `outputSchema` on individual and hybrid first-class tools (`advertise_output_schema=False` opts out)

views.command-metadata: , for commands with `returns` listed as their own tool, individual or first-class under hybrid (`create_server(advertise_output_schema=False)` opts out); the envelope does not require a property that accepts `null`, because Python's wire format omits model fields set to `None`

single.dispatch-order.note: matches through the stamp; no `onCommand` hook

single.active-context.note: trusted transport-session stacks, depth 16; stateless HTTP mutation returns `SESSION_REQUIRED`

single.in-process-context.note: local calls use a deliberate default scope; no per-call active context

single.exception-redaction.note: (`dev_mode` shows detail in the server, `create_command_registry`, `execute_pipeline` and `SimpleRegistry`)

single.cancellation.note: `asyncio` cancellation and `context.signal` (`asyncio.Event`); DirectClient and `MCPServer` enforce positive finite `context.timeout` and default `30000` ms (`default_timeout_ms`) deadlines, returning `TIMEOUT`; pre-cancelled single and batch calls return `COMMAND_CANCELLED` (#2129)

single.actor.note: MCP `agent`, `DirectClient` `human`, testing `test`; `SimpleRegistry` keyword-only `context` receives actor/clock/random (#431); never taken from caller `_meta`; with `auth`, verified `credentials.client_id` populates `actor.id` (#2154)

single.context-fields-mcp.note: both eras over Streamable HTTP, SSE and stdio; `server/discover` and `afd-help` (no AFD-native HTTP lanes)

views.cf-mcp: both eras over Streamable HTTP, SSE and stdio (no AFD-native HTTP lanes); `context_hook` wins; `server/discover` and `afd-help`

single.output-budgets.note: ([#1990](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/1990), #2186): `OutputBudget`, `output_budget` on `CommandDefinition`/`define_command`/`@server.command`, in-process & MCP asks, post-handler check, batches/pipelines and journal `outputBudget`; `test_output_budget_vectors.py` runs `spec/vectors/output-budgets.json`

views.pc-ob-b2: (`test_output_budget_vectors.py`, `test_output_budget_mcp.py`, #1990: `asks`/`checks`/`batch` over Streamable HTTP and stdio in both eras, plus an initialized-session SSE test)

single.journal-append-order.note: with the built-in sinks: the digest is synchronous and nothing is awaited before `append`; a custom async sink that awaits before assigning `seq` could reorder

middleware.approval-relay.note: (#1312): `create_approval_middleware(relay="mcp-elicitation")`; one SDK-sealed, principal-bound `requestState` per call with the confirmation's answers; in band on a 2025 stdio or stateful HTTP connection

views.approvals: (`create_approval_middleware(relay="mcp-elicitation")`; one SDK-sealed, principal-bound `requestState` per call carries confirmation and approval answers; in band on 2025 stdio or stateful HTTP)

middleware.up-front-approval.note: (#1312): on 2026-07-28 and in band on a 2025 stdio or stateful HTTP connection; `requestState` keeps each gated step's validated input, as in TypeScript

views.approvals: (on 2026-07-28 and in band on a 2025 stdio or stateful HTTP connection)

exec.batch.note: ([#1535](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/1535)): public `execute_batch` (`afd`, `afd.core`, `afd.server`) and `execute_batch()` on `CommandRegistry`, `MCPServer`, `SimpleRegistry` and `MockServer`; limits 500/16 (`check_batch_limits`), `stop_on_error` drains in-flight, caller cancellation stops scheduling (#2129)

exec.single-pipeline-engine.note: ([#1535](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/1535)): `DirectClient.pipe` delegates to core `execute_pipeline`, keeping only a public-shape adapter (`DirectPipelineResult` and legacy string `when`); single commands share `execute_command` across `CommandRegistry`, `SimpleRegistry`, `MockServer` and `MCPServer`

exec.stream-executor.note: ([#1535](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/1535)): public buffered `execute_stream` (`afd`, `afd.core`, `afd.server`) and `execute_stream()` on `CommandRegistry`, `MCPServer`, `SimpleRegistry` and `MockServer` (`StreamExecutorOptions`, `STREAM_ABORTED`, `STREAM_TIMEOUT`, B7 output-budget skip)

exec.timeout-progress.note: , with a Pythonic shape: `TimeoutController` is a deadline, not an `AbortController`; `run()` bounds an await by the time left, with `remaining_ms` and `is_expired`

hts.handoff-client.note: (#545 candidate): metadata then shared default; explicit options win

hts.telemetry-types.note: the core event serializes snake_case, and the middleware defines a second copy

mcp.tool-fields.note: annotations (`mutation: true` only), `structuredContent` on every route's result, and top-level `outputSchema` on individual and hybrid first-class tools (`advertise_output_schema=False` opts out); #465

views.cm-structured: (every tool result of every route, meta-tools, batch and pipeline included)

mcp.transport-context.note: ([#800](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/800), [#2154](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/2154)): `create_server(context_hook=...)` receives `ContextHookRequest` and base `CommandContext` (with verified `credentials` when `auth` is configured; cannot change them); its actor binds `requestState` and its `extra` wins over `_meta` fields

mcp.auth.verification.note: ([#2154](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/2154)): `create_server(..., auth=McpAuthOptions(...))` ASGI bearer layer on `streamable_http_app` and `sse_app` (fail-closed M1, `trusted_transport()`, stdio unaffected); `JwtVerifier` (`cryptography`), `KeySource`, `create_introspection_verifier`, frozen redacted `credentials`, 401/403 builders, RFC 9728 metadata; loads `spec/authorization.json`

mcp.auth.scopes.note: ([#2155](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/2155), #2193, [#2266](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/2266)): command `scopes`, `required_scopes`, `ScopeResolver` (`resolve`, `visible`, `known`), pre-dispatch 403 and `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`, `filter_tools_by_scope` (`cacheScope: "private"`), hidden commands unknown on every route and `tasks/*`, `server.admit`, `server.pre_dispatch_check`, `ScopeChallenge`, per-caller `ResourceProvider` (`ResourceCaller`, `cacheScope: "private"`); loads `staticScopes` and `batches`

views.command-metadata: ([#2155](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/2155): `scopes` on `CommandDefinition`, `@define_command` and `@server.command`, checked at registration, in `_meta`, grouped `_meta.actions`, `afd-detail` and `afd-help`; enforced with `auth`)

mcp.confirmation-principal-binding.note: (step 0c, [#800](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/800), [#2154](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/2154)): the SDK seals the state and binds the call's actor and verified credentials (from AFD's `auth` layer when configured, else the SDK token); a mismatch is `-32602`, as tampering is; incomplete token identity is an internal error

views.command-metadata: (step 0c, [#800](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/800), [#2154](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/2154)): the hook's actor (or server `actor`) and verified credentials (AFD `auth` or SDK token), through the SDK's `bind_principal`; a mismatch is `-32602` as tampering is
views.auth-m8: (step 0c, [#800](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/800), [#2154](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/2154); `afd.server.principal_binding`, with AFD's verified credentials or the SDK token; loads `principalBindings`)

mcp.server-instances.note: ([#2242](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/2242)): `instances` (`'single'` or `'multiple'`) on `create_server` and `ServerConfig`; `'multiple'` refuses unshared `confirmation_key` (≥ 32 B, copied) or `nonce_store` (sees `compose_middleware`); omitted warns once on HTTP, silent on stdio

mcp.host-verified-confirmation.note: ([#2264](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/2264)): `confirmation_mode="host-verified"` on `CommandDefinition`/`define_command`/`@server.command`, `HumanRelay` on `create_server` (single-command 2026-07-28, validated input, URL-mode elicitation, `approved_context`), private off-object relay evidence spent once as `relay:<decision_id>` by `create_approval_middleware`, `input_digest` (loads `inputDigests`)

views.approvals: ([#2264](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/2264)): an off-object private weakref carrier the server sets after `RelayApproved`, which `create_approval_middleware` checks in rule 3's order and spends once as `relay:<decision_id>` (24h TTL regardless of `replay`); cleared before the handler runs

mcp.auth.tasks.note: ([#1972](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/1972), [#2154](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/2154), [#2155](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/2155)): `tasks/*` fail closed, require `required_scopes`, bind AFD verified credentials as owner, stop at `credentials.expires_at`, preserve cloned verified credentials and `ScopeView`, enforce command scopes and hidden commands on `tasks/get` and `tasks/update` (not `tasks/cancel`)

mcp.resources.note: ([#1981](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/1981), [#2266](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/2266): `resources` option on `create_server`, Streamable HTTP, SSE and stdio in both eras; per-caller `ResourceCaller` and `"private"` `cacheScope` under `auth`; unused `prompts` and opt-out `resources` capabilities removed)

views.res-core: (`resources` option; Streamable HTTP, SSE and stdio, both eras; per-caller `ResourceCaller` and `"private"` `cacheScope` under `auth`, #2266; #1981)
views.res-vectors: (`tests/test_mcp_resources_vectors.py` and `test_tool_meta.py`, over Streamable HTTP and stdio; #1981)
views.pc-res: (`tests/test_mcp_resources_vectors.py`, `tests/test_mcp_auth_resources.py`, Streamable HTTP, SSE and stdio, both eras; #1981, #2266)

mcp.tool-meta.note: ([#1981](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/1981): `tool_meta` on `@server.command`/`define_command`/`CommandDefinition`, refused at definition and registration under the key rule)

mcp.raw-json-schema.note: `input_schema` takes a JSON Schema dict as well as a Pydantic model

mcp.output-budgets.note: ([#1990](https://github.com/lushly-dev/afd/issues/1990), #2186): `_meta["dev.afd/outputBudget"]` on individual and hybrid first-class tools, grouped `_meta.actions`, `afd-detail`, `afd-help` (`full`) and `afd-docs`; per-call ask in `tools/call` `_meta` and meta-tools' `meta` over Streamable HTTP and stdio in both eras, plus initialized SSE

mcp.context-tools.note: backed by trusted transport sessions, with a deliberate local/default scope

mcp.http-hardening.note: SDK `transport_security` defaults (foreign `Origin` refused); body cap through `max_request_body_size`

mcp.jsonrpc-types.note: Pythonic names; no notification type or error-code constants

pc.get-405.note: not asserted (the SDK's 2025 stateless lane opens an SSE stream)

tooling.mcp-client.note: `StreamableHttpTransport` (`mcp.Client`, `protocol_mode`) by default; reconnect refreshes discovery without replaying calls; `stream` needs a server with `/stream` (#548). Deprecated `http` sends no session ID (see Intended differences)

tooling.direct-client.note: (#545 candidate): validating `create_direct_registry` enforces exposure; fail-closed `allow` (carried into nested calls), ordered middleware and millisecond deadlines on `DirectClient`; legacy registries remain host adapters

tooling.cli.note: `batch` and `stream` take TypeScript's arguments (#548); `call` and `shell` take JSON or `key=value`, and commands send `-H`/`AFD_HEADERS` (#1822); connection is `--server`; `stream` needs `/stream`. No `scenario`

single.context-fields-meta-delivery.note: (`test_context_fields_mcp.py`: Streamable HTTP, stdio and SSE, both eras)
